headline: Batch mastering: Fixed Peak, LUFS, or 1o1 against each file's source
highlights: Fixed Peak, LUFS or 1o1 source matching, with ceiling, boost/cut limits and compensation (comma or point)
Transparent true-peak limiter; a gentle compressor only when it helps; any shortfall reported, never crushed
Unmatched files flagged before the run, M/S/C tags, templates with notes, and saved sessions
